notes: SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on the REPAIRED ContextMemory write path. Discharges IGW-20260803-212 (ARC-045 pending_retest_after_substrate=true). Successor to V3-EXQ-436c, which was a fair, non-degenerate test whose primary DV (slot_cosine_sim differentiation, C1) FAILED 0/5 seeds in the OPPOSITE direction (SWS_THEN_REM homogenized whole-bank cosine to ~0.9999-1.0 in 4/5 seeds) -- root-caused by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436c_2026-08-03 (confirmed) to ContextMemory.write()'s write_gate behaving as constant content (sigmoid-midpoint 0.5*ones) rather than a modulator. The ONLY change here is the substrate flag contextmemory_gated_content_write=True (ree-v3 5f331fe, default-OFF and bit-identical until opted in), which restores write_gate to a modulator so writes are content-bearing: write_signal = sigmoid(write_gate_pre(x)) * write_content(x). The flag is held CONSTANT across both conditions (a substrate property, like the noise floor); the manipulation under test is still sleep (SWS_THEN_REM vs WAKING_ONLY). Conditions, DVs, thresholds (C1 >= 3/5, P0 write-counter gate), seeds, and action-selection wiring are otherwise UNCHANGED from 436c. With the homogenization confound removed, a C1 FAIL here (P0 met) is now a genuine weakens rather than a write-path artifact, and a C1 PASS is genuine support. The P0 gate (introduced in 436c) still guards against an unrecorded/unfired write path. Authoring probe: legacy path drives 200-write off-diagonal cosine to 0.99993 (seed 2) vs 0.02487 with the flag on -- differentiation, the predicted direction.
